mainEntity.name: Will my San Diego dog bite case go to court?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many San Diego dog bite cases are resolved through negotiation and settlement outside of court. Your lawyer will typically attempt to reach a fair settlement with the dog owner's insurance company. However, if a fair settlement cannot be reached, or if liability is heavily disputed, your case may proceed to litigation and potentially a trial. The decision to go to court is usually made after careful consideration of the evidence, settlement offers, and your best interests. Your attorney will advise you throughout this process.
